subject: Re: Sparklo — interest in a short pilot and demo
messages:
From: Evan Liu <evan@sparklo.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0400 (EDT)
Subject: Interest in Redwood for Sparklo — pilot + demo

Hi Maya,

We signed up for a self-serve trial today and I wanted to follow up directly to see if we could schedule a short demo this month. Quick context: we run an in-app search and an assistant for customer support. We’re evaluating moving embeddings + a chat model to a hosted inference provider to reduce latency and cost.

Rough numbers:~
- Monthly queries: ~6M (≈200k/day peak)
- Typical request length: ~200-400 tokens after prompt
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for chat responses

Timeline: pilot in July, goal to be in production by Q4 if results look good.

I attached a quick traffic estimate matrix. Would appreciate a 30–45 minute walkthrough focused on: model options for latency/cost, security controls (VPC/KMS), and recommended pilot sizing.

Attendees likely: me (engineering lead), Priya (product). We’re in PDT.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Liu
Eng Lead, Sparklo
Attachment: sparklo-traffic-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
To: Evan Liu <evan@sparklo.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0400 (EDT)
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for Sparklo — pilot + demo

Hi Evan — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet, that helps. I’m Maya on the inbound team; happy to run a focused 30–45 minute demo and make sure we cover the things you listed. A couple quick qualification questions so we tailor the session:

• Primary use case: is the assistant serving private customer data, or only product/content (no PII)?
• Traffic pattern: is the 200k/day a steady average or concentrated bursts during launches?
• Pilot scale: when you say "pilot in July" — do you mean a 1–2 week technical pilot (validation) or a full production pilot with an integration and live traffic?
• Region preference: do you need EU data residency, or is US regions OK?

Proposed slots (30–45m) — all PDT as you mentioned:
- Wed 6/16 10:00–10:45am PDT
- Thu 6/17 1:00–1:45pm PDT
- Fri 6/18 9:00–9:45am PDT

If none of those work, share 2–3 windows and I’ll have my calendar link. Also looping Ben (SDR) who can lock the invite and coordinate follow-ups; Marissa (AE) will join the call if we get into pricing/commitment questions.

Cheers,
Maya Srinivasan
Inbound SDR, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Evan Liu <evan@sparklo.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@sparklo.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 18:15:00 +0000 (UTC)
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood for Sparklo — pilot + demo

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick reply and the slots. Answers below:

• Primary data: mix of product content and customer-support transcripts (contains some PII). We’ll need to discuss encryption/KMS and retention policies.
• Traffic: somewhat bursty — launches cause 4–5x spikes for a few hours. Average is nearer 150k/day, peaks ~400k/day.
• Pilot: looking for a 2–3 week technical pilot that validates latency, cost, and KV/prefix caching behavior with a small slice of traffic (few thousand qps during the test window). Production rollout later if successful.
• Region: US regions OK (we’re on AWS us-west mainly).

For the meeting, our preferred time is Thu 6/17 1:00pm PDT (which is your 1:00–1:45pm slot). Attendees: me, Priya (product), and one infra engineer (TBD).

One ask — can you include any quick best-practices for handling customer transcripts (redaction, retention settings) in the call?

Thanks,
Evan
Attachment: sparklo-arch-notes.pdf (high-level notes)
